name: Amangani
address: 1535 North East Butte Road, Jackson, WY 83001, United States
closedUntil: Closed for an extensive refurbishment, with reopening described as coming soon and no date given (checked 9 Nov 2026)
tagline: Suites and hillside homes on East Gros Ventre Butte, above Jackson Hole.
description:
Amangani stands on East Gros Ventre Butte, in the foothills of the Tetons, above Jackson Hole. Redwood and sandstone form the buildings, which look across the peaks and plains of the Snake River Valley. The resort is closed for an extensive refurbishment, with reopening described as coming soon and no date given.

Suites are finished in wood and stone, each with a balcony or terrace. A Deluxe Suite measures 45.3 square metres, or 488 square feet, and combines a king bedroom and living area with a gas fireplace and a window-side daybed. The Grand Teton Suite measures 58 square metres, or 625 square feet, with a separate living room, a king bedroom and a wraparound balcony. The Gros Ventre Suite is the same size and looks over the valley from large balconies. Spring Gulch measures 62 square metres, or 676 square feet, with a wraparound balcony above the pool and the valley. Sena measures 72 square metres, or 780 square feet, toward the Snake River Valley. The Amangani Suite is listed at the same 72 square metres and 780 square feet, with a guest bathroom, and it can connect to a Superior Suite.

Three homes sit on the hillside: East Tatanka, West Tatanka and Wapiti. East Tatanka is a four-bedroom house of 583 square metres, or 6,275 square feet, for groups of up to ten. Three bedrooms have king beds and the fourth has four twin beds. The house has a dining table for ten, a full kitchen, a hot tub, a fitness studio and a private office.

The Grill is open for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Redwood panelling and floor-to-ceiling windows face the Teton Range, with an outdoor Grand Terrace. Executive Chef Manuel Fernandez writes the menu, which has included caribou sausages, elk T-bone, bison short rib, lobster, trout, halibut, Idaho potatoes and Utah honeycomb. A five-course tasting menu can be served outdoors or on a suite terrace. Zinc Bar, with sandstone columns and redwood panelling, pours locally brewed beer and spirits distilled nearby, including a huckleberry martini and a spicy hibiscus margarita.

The wellness centre has four redwood-panelled treatment rooms, movement and fitness studios and two steam rooms, plus a fitness centre open through the night. A heated outdoor pool runs 35 metres beside a hot tub. In winter a ski lounge in Teton Village is a 20-minute drive, steps from the Bridger Gondola and the Aerial Tram. Heli-skiing is arranged over 305,000 acres, with descents of 12,000 to 15,000 feet. Summer brings horse riding, kayaking and cycling. Grand Teton National Park is close, and Yellowstone holds more than two million acres, including Old Faithful. A buy-out is offered for 50 to 75 guests. Jackson Hole Airport, inside Grand Teton National Park, is a 25-minute drive, and the town of Jackson is about 10 minutes by car.
